tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dkor bdag jo mo legs ldan ma'i 'phrin las bzhugs so// dkor bdag jo mo legs ldan ma'i 'phrin las ni/ oṃ badzra sa tu bha ti nā ga raksha ni dun dun ma ma/ bhyoḥhūm̐ dza phaṭa/ oṃ nā ga kro ti shwa ri khang mu le rbad/ thang mu le rbad/ che ge mo'i snying rtsa la rbad/ oṃ nag mo dun dun bhyoḥ bhyoḥshig shig che ge mo'i srog rtsa la mā ra ya rbad rbad/ bhyoḥdad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur byon rdo rje legs ldan ma/ /rdo rje phug bdag spun dgu dang / /ming po bdud nag ral pa can/ /bran bdud klu btsan sman dang bzod/ /'brog dang lo bdud lo btsan dang / /sa bdag klu gnyen 'khor gyis bskor/ /rdo rje klu 'brog 'khor bcas rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /legs ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid legs ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra sa tu bha ti nā ga raksha kro ta shwa ri/ a karṣa ya hrīḥdzaḥdzaḥ sa mā ya tiṣṭha lhan/ bhyoḥm gcig rdo rje legs ldan la/ /yang don don dam thugs su chud/ /lta ba mtho ba'i mtho ldan ma/ /bslab sdom dam tshig dri ma med/ /dam tshig gtsang ba'i gtsang ldan ma/ /mdzad spyod dam pa'i chos dang mthun/ /spyod pa legs pa'i legs ldan ni/ /ci bcol ma lus thams cad nyan/ /las rnams sgrub pa'i sgrub ldan ma/ /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung / /mthu rtsal che ba'i che ldan ma/ /zhi ba'i ngang la bzhugs tsa na/ /dge bsnyen chen po'i cha lugs can/ /sku la dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /dbu la rin chen rgyan gyi brgyan/ /dar man gdan la skyil krung bzhugs/ /phyag g.yas mthing gi bum pa bsnams/ /dam tshig can gyi rigs brgyud spel/ /g.yon pa shel dkar bum pa bsnams/ /legs nyes gnyis kyi btang 'dzin ma/ /sman dang yul sa 'khor gyis bskor/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /zhal zas dri mchog rol mo'i sgra/

/rtsi sman bcud dang rin chen lnga/ /dar zab dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs/ /dam rdzas gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la/ /nad gdon dgra bgegs zhi bar mdzod/ /'khor dang longs spyod spel bar mdzod/ /bhyoḥm gcig rdo rje legs ldan ma/ /byams pa'i bzhin bzang 'gyur ba med/ /dam ldan bu la brtse zhing gdung / /ri rab mtho la gnas bcas shing / /sku la gna' ba'i thul pa gsol/ /chibs su sha ba yu mo chibs/ /rdo bu kha dkar rol du khrid/ /phyag g.yas gnam lcags phur pa sgril/ /tshe srog rku ba'i dgra la rdeg /phyag g.yon sha 'breng zhags pa 'debs/ /dkor zan dam nyams mgul du 'ching / /dam rdzas mdos dang gtor ma yis/ /dkor bdag rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang / /'khor srungs rkyen bzlog dgra bgegs thul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /gter ston sangs rgyas bla ma'i gter byon lhad med do/ /'di sngar glo bo'i bskang phrin snying ma'i dpe rigs las 'phros gtsang zhig rig 'dzin chen por zhus pas/ bskang phrin 'os min sna tshogs dor snang gis/ khungs ldan rnams bshus te glo bo'i thugs grub las brgyud pa'i bka' srung dam can chog bsgrigs su/ skyabs mgon rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus bsgrigs gnang las khol du bton pa yin lags// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dkor bdag jo mo legs ldan ma'i 'phrin las/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
